title: Swan's Economy Mod
description: Money in Minecraft Java alongside a Shop, a Sell system, an Auction House, Jobs and a Bounty Board
body:
### Swan's Economy Mod -- Early development -- Features and Extras

_This is still an early test version so not all features are included or fully functional or fleshed out until v1.0.0_

**Features:**   
Shop -- Sell System -- Auction House -- Bounties -- Jobs -- Scoreboard -- Money for killing hostile mobs

**Commands:**   
`/balance` or `/bal` =>  shows the players balance in chat   
`/shop` =>  opens the shop   
`/sell` =>  opens the sell menu   
`/ah` =>  opens the auction house   
`/bounty` =>  opens the bounty board   
`/job` =>  opens the job panel   
`/worth <item>` =>  lists the held item's value in chat   
`/pay` =>  give a player money

**Currently working on:**       
-Some commands related to teleportation such as `!home` and `!tpa`   
-Admin commands  _//beta almost ready_  
-Combat System   
-UI that joins all the features together accessible through an item.  _//beta almost ready_   
-Ranks   
-Land claiming    
-Money related features   
-Updating existing features such as the auction house and the bounty board   

**Suggestions and Feedback:**   
Leave your suggestions, bug reports and requests in the comment section (discord serever coming soon if the mod gets 1000 downloads) to shape future updates.

**Known Bugs:**   
-selling shulker boxes with items inside them in the Auction House will remove the items in them (buying or cancelling the item will give an empty shulker)  _//working out a fix_

**Dependencies:**   
Fabric API  
Java 25

Mod created by The_evening_swan7733 -- Originates from Minecraft Bedrock

BETA and ALPHA files coming each week for testing

PLEASE DO NOT REUPLOAD THE MOD ON ANY SITE OR CLAIM IT WAS YOURS.

DO NOT SELL OR SHARE MODIFIED OR UNMODIFIED VERSIONS OF THE MOD.
